tiktok-transcript 1.0.0

- First release: extract full transcripts, on-screen text, captions, title, hashtags, key points, and stats from TikTok (and similar) videos via link.
- Summarizes or translates content on request.
- Free one-summary-per-day without API key; full output with optional (free) API key tied to usage credits.
- No download, TikTok account, or browser cookies required.
- Python script and HTTP API options provided for easy integration.
- Detailed documentation in SKILL.md covers usage, API parameters, limitations, and privacy.
